cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says a government digital-skills programme for the public is in service and has trained a stated number of people.
cells.note: The World Bank's December 2023 appraisal of PACTDIGITAL includes a US$22 million digital-skills component, and the digital ministry reported skills training for 169 girls in 2025. No national programme's count has been found, so not stage 3.
